title: IM Channels
description: Connect IM bots to agents: users ask in a private chat, the agent works in its sandbox, and the result comes back to the same chat.
notice: Access is open by default: anyone who can message the bot can drive the agent behind it. Narrow the bot visibility in the platform console, or switch the instance to allowlist mode.

list.emptyDescription: Once a bot is connected, users can drive the agent directly from a private chat.
list.catalogFailed: Failed to load the channel catalog

provision.title: Connect a bot
provision.description: Scanning lets the platform authorize and create the bot; use manual credentials when scanning is unavailable.
provision.unsupported: This channel does not support scanning; use manual credentials.
provision.qrHint: Scan the QR code with the matching app and confirm. This page polls the status automatically.
provision.qrExpired: The QR code has expired, please generate a new one.
provision.expiredHint: The QR code lifetime is decided by the platform; generate a new one to retry.
provision.failedHint: Provisioning failed ({{code}}). Retry later or use manual credentials.
provision.manualHint: You can submit platform credentials directly; this is also the only way back in after losing them.
provision.agentLabel: Bind agent (optional, can be done later)
provision.ownerRefPlaceholder: An opaque label defined by the caller
provision.ownerRefHint: The service stores and returns it verbatim; it is never parsed or used for authorization.

deleteDialog.title: Delete channel instance
deleteDialog.description: Deleting disconnects the bot and removes its routes and credentials; connecting again requires a new provisioning. Delete "{{name}}"?

test.title: Connectivity test
test.description: Send a fixed message to one user to check whether delivery works right now. It does not run a turn or write chat history.
test.userPlaceholder: Platform user identifier, e.g. the WeCom userid
test.disconnectedHint: The instance is not connected; the test may fail. Try "Reconnect" first.

result.rejected: The platform confirmed it was not delivered; check the credentials and the user id, then retry.
result.uncertain: Timed out or the connection dropped, so delivery cannot be determined. It will not be resent, to avoid duplicate messages.

policy.title: Access policy
policy.description: Decides who may talk to the bot. It is business data in the database and takes effect immediately, without a restart.
policy.groupHint: The MVP does not allow any group message, so the group policy has no effect yet.
policy.allowlistEmpty: An empty allowlist rejects everyone while allowlist mode is on.
policy.openWarning: Open means anyone who can message the bot can drive the agent behind it (run tools, consume quota, read and write its workspace).
policy.allowCommandsHint: The command layer is modeled but not enforced in the MVP.
policy.saved: Access policy updated and effective immediately
policy.saveFailed: Failed to save the access policy
policy.loadFailed: Failed to load the access policy

errors.CHANNEL_GATEWAY_DISABLED: The channel gateway is not running (multiple workers or a missing encryption key). Check the deployment.
errors.CHANNEL_INSTANCE_NOT_FOUND: The instance does not exist or is not connected.
errors.CHANNEL_INSTANCE_OFFLINE: The bot is not connected right now; reconnect it first.
errors.CHANNEL_CREDENTIAL_INVALID: The bot credentials are no longer valid; connect it again.
errors.CHANNEL_CREDENTIALS_INVALID: The credentials were rejected; please check and retry.
errors.CHANNEL_AGENT_NOT_BOUND: This bot has no usable agent right now; please contact the deployment owner.
errors.CHANNEL_AGENT_NOT_RUNNABLE: The bound agent is not runnable right now.
errors.CHANNEL_ADAPTER_UNKNOWN: This channel is not registered; refresh and retry.
errors.CHANNEL_PROVISIONING_NOT_FOUND: The provisioning attempt does not exist or was cleaned up.
errors.CHANNEL_PROVISIONING_EXPIRED: The QR code has expired; generate a new one.
errors.CHANNEL_SECRET_KEY_INVALID: The server has no channel encryption key (WITTY_CHANNEL_SECRET_KEY) configured; please contact the deployment owner.
